resources.string: No paired printer found. Pair your Canon Ivy 2 in the system Bluetooth settings first (it shows up as \"Canon (xx:xx) Mini Printer\").

1. Pair the Ivy 2 in the Bluetooth settings.
2. Turn on this phone's Wi-Fi hotspot (or put phone and camera on the same Wi-Fi).
3. On the camera, join that network in CanonDirectPrint → Wi-Fi settings.
4. Start the bridge, then print from the camera. The camera finds the bridge automatically.
